basic_info.name: Primordials — Living Ecosystem
basic_info.short_description: Watch a real ecosystem live on your desktop. Inspired by Lotka-Volterra predator-prey dynamics, Primordials runs as a live wallpaper, screensaver, or windowed app — and looks alive.
basic_info.about_the_game:
🌿 WATCH LIFE UNFOLD ON YOUR DESKTOP

Primordials is a desktop-native artificial life simulation that turns any monitor into a window into a primordial world. Inspired by the classic Lotka-Volterra predator-prey equations, every organism you see is following real ecological rules: births, hunger, reproduction, and death.

— WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT —
Unlike traditional screensavers or live wallpapers, Primordials isn't looping video. It's a true simulation. You can tune the parameters, add new species, change the carrying capacity, and watch how the system responds. The ecosystem you see is genuinely alive.

— FEATURES —
🧬 Real Lotka-Volterra dynamics
🌿 6 biomes included (Algae Bloom, Deep Sea, Primordial Soup, Tundra, Coral Reef, Volcanic Vent)
🎨 Distinctive polygonal vector art
🖥️ 3 modes: Live Wallpaper, Screensaver, Windowed App
⚡ High-performance C++23 ECS engine — 250K+ entities @ 60 FPS
💾 Optional cloud-save for biome configurations (Supabase)
🛠️ Custom biome support via JSON config
🔌 Steam Workshop support (planned)
📦 Open source (MIT) on GitHub

— BY GENSOULS LAB —
Primordials is developed solo by Sahil Khutey under the Gensouls Lab indie banner. It's a passion project for everyone who's ever stared at a screensaver and wished it was alive.
